description_en: Queries the number of risk items detected in the configuration assessment of one or more cloud services by using the instance IDs of the cloud services
description_zh: 根据云产品实例ID查看单个或多个云产品中云平台配置检查风险项的个数
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-risk-list-check-result --source-ip 59.57.XX.XX --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids rm-bp1e8t4q15sr30000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRiskListCheckResult

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：  
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance IDs of the cloud services that you want to query. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

If you do not specify this parameter, an empty list is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的云产品实例ID。多个ID使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
不传入实例ID时，调用该接口会返回空的风险项列表信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

List.description_en: The number of risk items for each cloud service

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the cloud service

riskCount.description_en: The total number of risk items detected in the current cloud service
riskCount.description_zh: 当前云产品实例上存在的风险项总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
